safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated lists Clenil as a medication (Medications-002) but does not state the baseline dosing of 2 puffs twice daily (only the increased dose is documented in the plan).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s baseline Clenil dosing (2 puffs BID) weakens medication reconciliation and makes it harder to judge current controller adherence and severity of the exacerbation. This can lead to confusion about what “step-up” dosing represents and may contribute to inappropriate dosing or follow-up instructions.
